gameDescriptionHtml:
Every fan believes they could do it differently. In FM27 belief isn’t a hot take, it’s a story waiting to happen.

Step into a living, breathing football universe where every decision is yours to make. 

Pick the team. Define your style. Spot what other managers might miss. Maybe you take a chance on the academy prospect. Maybe you sell the star who just doesn’t get your vision.

Train your team to work as one. Build a tactical blueprint that’s unmistakably yours. Then lead your team out to admiration from the stands as you take your place on the touchline.

Match day. React to everything the opposition throws at you. Beat their press. Fill the box. And throw the kitchen sink.

Because footballing history won’t write itself.

Every decision could be the one to change everything. So chase the vision only you can see. 
Whatever happens, you’ll remember the calls that got you there.

Football Manager 27. Make The Call.

What’s new for FM27?

Experience a new dimension to squad building with all-new Tactical Effectiveness that measures how well-equipped your players are to deliver your footballing vision, while refreshed training puts even more focus on player and team development.

Exploit the gaps you see in the opposition defence with Tactical Tweaks that deliver a new layer of influence from the touchline.

Experience every fixture as a richer piece of football theatre thanks to upgrades to crowds, stadiums and environments that elevate the stage for your players to perform on.

Sit defenders down with more attacking precision and expression, with flair and individuality taking centre stage to make it more rewarding seeing your tactical planning come to life on the pitch.

Get lost in the wider football world that exists beyond your club with the return of Cup Draws and Transfer Deadline Day, mirroring the pace and drama of the football calendar.

Flow through game weeks to glory thanks to an intuitive interface that puts key decisions front and centre. However you execute your managerial vision, customisation options mean you can tailor your setup to better suit your style.

And discover much more, including new licensed leagues to test your skills in, upgrades to the 2D Match View, deeper data to power decision-making and more than 1,500 competition updates.
